dispatched.title: Unclosed file handle
dispatched.description: The file opened via open(path) is never closed if the loop below raises, leaking a file descriptor per failed parse.
dispatched.suggestion: Use a context manager (with open(path) as f) instead.

dispatched.title: Claimed race condition in cache eviction
dispatched.description: The finding cites a lock acquisition around cache eviction at these lines, but no such code exists in the current file.
dispatched.suggestion: Confirm the lock is actually held at the reported location before filing.
